scope: Scratch graphics-GPU packed scatter prototype; application backend not implemented.

dependencies.location: Owned prototype scratch only; application installation unchanged.

limits: Scratch-only experiment; no application renderer or preferences changed.
GPU timing includes point preparation, uploads, dispatch and full readback; actual native-sized packed pixels are compared with the current CPU material.
Only the default spaCR palette with zero dot flicker and no colour-wave event is in this first experiment; no random-palette or full native-widget acceptance claimed.
Other agents are active on CPU; these measurements alone do not establish production speedup.
CPU has one warmed material sample per case; GPU has eight. This is not a controlled paired speed comparison.
Readback overhead is substantial and several cases are slower. A default GPU switch is not justified by these results.
Further work must include owned QImage readback, persistent buffers, paired CPU/GPU timing, random palette/effects and fail-safe thread lifetime before application integration.
